note: Named, deterministic skill chains. The scoring router suggests ad-hoc chains; these are canonical workflows an agent can invoke by name.

chains.name: deep-research
chains.description: Research a topic on the web, verify sources, fact-check, summarize, and produce a Markdown report.
chains.rationale: web-first collection -> verification -> synthesis -> document output

chains.name: anti-procrastination
chains.description: Un-stick the user, decompose the task, prioritize, then protect focused work.
chains.rationale: momentum first, then structure, then a defended focus session

chains.name: code-review-flow
chains.description: Request a structured review, receive feedback, and verify before completion.
chains.rationale: ask -> absorb -> verify before calling work done

chains.name: document-processing
chains.description: Load, summarize, and re-export a document into Markdown.
